summary: This bill amends the Better Utilization of Investments Leading to Development Act of 2018 to redefine the role and responsibilities of the Chief Development Officer within the United States International Development Finance Corporation, granting them more authority in international development policy and interagency coordination.

scores.thoughts: This bill strengthens the development mandate of the United States International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) by modifying the role and responsibilities of its Chief Development Officer. The DFC provides financing for private sector development in developing countries, which is a form of foreign aid. By enhancing the DFC's capacity and focus on international development, the bill aims to make foreign aid more effective and strategic, thus increasing its impact.
